title: Administrator
description:

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Sewell Wallis are currently recruiting for an Assistant Accountant to join a well-established and successful business based in Barnsley, South Yorkshire.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious finance professional to take ownership of the transactional finance function, overseeing purchase ledger, sales ledger and credit control across a diverse portfolio of key clients and accounts.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you ll become their right-hand person within the transactional finance team, taking ownership of the day-to-day function and providing valuable support, allowing the Finance Manager to focus on wider financial reporting and strategic priorities.

We re looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and enjoys taking ownership. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy variety in your day and want to be part of a friendly, social and upbeat team, this could be the perfect next step for you.

What will you be doing?
- Perform daily GBP and USD bank reconciliations, including PayPal, Sage Pay and other payment platforms, investigating and resolving discrepancies promptly.
- Manage the purchase ledger, processing supplier invoices, credit notes, purchase orders and supplier statements, while resolving invoice queries and disputes.
- Set up and maintain supplier accounts, verify bank details in line with company procedures, and manage supplier remittances and payment queries.
- Process weekly, monthly, China and ad hoc supplier payment runs, alongside employee expenses, petty cash and company credit card reconciliations.
- Provide credit control support, including chasing overdue customer debt and maintaining strong relationships with customers and suppliers.
- Analyse and review credit card and expense expenditure, ensuring transactions are accurately coded and supported by appropriate documentation.
- Manage intercompany recharges and reconciliations, while working closely with overseas and China-based suppliers and supporting import duty and declaration queries.
- Support month-end accounting and reporting, including accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, balance sheet reconciliations, management accounts, financial analysis, audit and VAT processes.

What skills are we looking for?
- Significant experience working in an Assistant Accountant or similar role
- AAT qualified, or studying towards
- Excellent understanding of Microsoft Excel, including SUMIFS, XLOOKUPs and VLOOKUPs
- Experience working with foreign currency transactions would be beneficial
- Understanding of accruals, prepayments and fixed assets would be beneficial
- Experience using Sage

What's on offer?
- Salary of £30,0000
- Parking available on site
- Pension Contributions
- Opportunity for development
- Freebies and company gifts
- Social events

Send us your CV below, or contact Inci Evcil for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. We are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About Us

Haywood & Padgett Ltd is an established food manufacturing business based in Barnsley, producing high-quality bakery products for customers across the UK.

Our people are at the heart of our business. As we continue to develop, we are looking for a Training Coordinator with food manufacturing experience to help ensure our employees have the skills, knowledge and confidence to do their jobs safely, effectively and to the required standards.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of training across our site, working closely with managers and teams throughout the business to improve skills, support development and maintain high standards.

Role

Reporting to the HR Manager, you will coordinate and deliver training across our manufacturing operation, covering areas such as food safety, quality, health and safety, operational procedures and employee development.

You will spend time on the shop floor, working directly with employees and managers to identify training needs, deliver practical training and ensure employees understand and can confidently carry out their roles.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes a hands-on approach and can help build a consistent and effective training programme across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Coordinate and deliver training across production, hygiene, technical, warehouse and other departments.

Identify training needs and maintain training plans, training matrices and skills records.

Deliver practical training on food safety, hygiene, metal detection, coding and labelling, sieving, quality standards and other relevant manufacturing procedures.

Assess employees' understanding and practical competence, ensuring they are confident and capable before being signed off.

Work with managers and team leaders to identify skills gaps and ensure training is completed on time.

Coordinate refresher training and maintain accurate training and competency records.

Manage the company's online training platform, including course allocation, completion monitoring and reporting.

Develop clear and engaging training materials, including presentations, visual guides, toolbox talks and practical demonstrations.

Review training requirements following changes to processes, equipment, procedures, incidents or audit findings.

Support employee development, skills progression and opportunities for internal promotion.

Help improve the company's induction, training and development processes to ensure a consistent approach across all shifts.

Ensure training records are accurate, up to date and ready for customer, certification and internal audits.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

Previous experience working in food manufacturing is essential.

Experience delivering workplace training, coaching colleagues or coordinating training within a manufacturing environment.

A good understanding of food safety, hygiene, quality standards and health and safety within food production.

The ability to explain procedures clearly and deliver practical, engaging training.

Experience maintaining training records, skills matrices or competency assessments.

Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple training requirements and deadlines.

Confident communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with employees and managers.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and the ability to maintain accurate records.

Flexibility to work across different shifts when required to support training needs.

Desirable Qualifications

A recognised Train the Trainer qualification.

Level 3 Award in Education and Training or an equivalent training qualification.

Level 3 Food Safety in Manufacturing.

Level 3 HACCP or equivalent.

Experience using an online learning or training management system.

Experience supporting employee development or training new starters.

We are happy to consider candidates who have the right food manufacturing and practical training experience but do not hold all the qualifications listed.

The Person

Approachable, enthusiastic and passionate about helping people learn.

Confident delivering practical training in a busy manufacturing environment.

A clear communicator who can adapt their approach to different employees and learning needs.

Comfortable working closely with production teams, managers and other departments.

Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve training and employee performance.

Professional and discreet when handling confidential employee information.

Confidentiality is essential. As part of the HR function, you will have access to sensitive employee and business information.

Benefits

264 hours' annual leave per year.

Enhanced sick pay.

Private medical insurance.

Company pension scheme.

Cycle to Work scheme.

Discounted gym membership.

Company shop membership.

Free on-site parking

Benefits:

Cycle to work scheme

On-site parking

Private medical insurance

Sick pay

Store discount

Experience:

Food Manufacturing: 2 years (preferred)

Staff training: 2 years (preferred)

Work Location: In person
